```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/ecoflor_submissions.R")

sessions <- tryCatch(read_sessions(), error = function(e) tibble())
contributions <- tryCatch({
  subs <- read_tab("Submissions") %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ str_trim(replace_na(.x, ""))))
  subs %>%
    filter(Status == "Accepted", Final_format %in% c(TALK_FORMATS, "Poster")) %>%
    mutate(
      Session_ID = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Session_ID)),
      Order = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Order)),
      Presenter = str_squish(paste(First_name, Last_name)),
      Student = Career_stage %in% c("Bachelor or Master student", "PhD student")
    ) %>%
    left_join(sessions, by = "Session_ID", suffix = c("", "_session")) %>%
    arrange(Session_ID, Order)
}, error = function(e) tibble())

orals <- if (nrow(contributions)) {
  contributions %>% filter(Final_format %in% TALK_FORMATS) %>% add_talk_times()
} else {
  tibble()
}

posters <- if (nrow(contributions)) {
  contributions %>% filter(Final_format == "Poster") %>% mutate(Poster_no = row_number())
} else {
  tibble()
}

render_session_slot <- function(day_name, start_time, fallback_label) {
  s <- sessions %>% filter(Day == day_name, Start_time == start_time, Type != "Poster")
  if (nrow(s) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("| **%s** | 🗣 **%s** *(session to be assigned)* |\n", start_time, fallback_label))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  s <- s[1, ]
  chair_txt <- if (!is.na(s$Chair) && s$Chair != "") paste0(" *(Chair: ", s$Chair, ")*") else ""
  cat(sprintf("| **%s** | 🗣 **Session %s: %s**%s |\n", start_time, s$Session_ID, s$Session_Name, chair_txt))
}
```

**3–6 February 2027 · Faculty of Science, Charles University · Viničná 7, Prague (Velká zoologická posluchárna, 2nd floor)**

::: {.callout-note}
**Interactive Programme & Session Builder:** Scientific committee members can evaluate abstracts, assign Oral / Rising Star / Poster formats, and reorder the thematic sessions into any of the time slots below using the [**Scientific Committee Review & Programme Builder App**](review.html).
:::
